pages.text: $(bold)Overland Military Logistics$()$(br2)Due to physical carry limits (1 long arm, 2 sidearms), armed regiments cannot march with armories in backpacks.$(br2)Heavy oak and brass crates allow moving arms in bulk across the realm via Trotting Wagons, Pack Mules, and Create Trains.

$(bold)Packing Recipes (Crafting Bench)$()$(br2)$(bold)Musket Crate:$() 8 FK15 Muskets + 1 Brass Sheet + 1 Oak Chest.$(br)$(bold)Pistol Crate:$() 8 FK15-P Pistols + 1 Brass Sheet + 1 Oak Chest.$(br)$(bold)Ammo Crate:$() 4x 64 Ammunition (256 rounds) + 1 Brass Sheet + 1 Oak Chest.

$(bold)Unpacking in the Field$()$(br2)To unseal a logistics crate:$(br)• Place it into any crafting table to retrieve the contents, OR$(br)• Hold Shift and Right-Click the ground to instantly deploy the weapons at your feet.$(br2)Crates bypass personal carry limits until unsealed.
